subject: Proposal: Annual prepay + staged ramp (ClearWave Health)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearwavehealth.com>, procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: annual prepay + staged ramp (ClearWave Health)

Hi Lena / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, attached is a proposed structure to move ClearWave from monthly billing to an annual prepay that balances an immediate unit discount with protections for your paced ramp during the first year. Highlights below — full numbers in the attached pricing-matrix-CW-v3.xlsx.

Proposal highlights:
- Commitment: 2-year annual prepay (invoices yearly) or 1-year annual prepay (option)
- Discounting: 20% off posted usage rates in Year 1 (2-yr commit), 25% in Year 2 (accelerator). 1-yr commit: 18% Year 1 only.
- Staged ramp / true-up: Monthly true-up with a 6-month soft ramp window: if you underutilize in months 1-6 we provide a one-time onboarding credit to offset the difference; after month 6 standard true-up applies.
- Onboarding credits: $25,000 professional services credit for migration and prompt engineering support (applies once, applied to first invoice).
- SLA & service credits: We can include a 99.9% uptime SLA with capped service-credit tiers; production latency SLAs (99th pct) are available as a paid add-on or via a higher-commit tier.
- Early termination: pro-rated refund of unused prepay after a 90-day notice and a 6-month minimum usage true-up.

Requested next steps: confirm whether you prefer 1- or 2-year term and if the 6-month ramp window aligns with your deployment plan. If you want faster ramp support (3 months), we can trade for a modest decrease in the Year 1 discount.

Attachments: pricing-matrix-CW-v3.xlsx, SOW-Onboarding-CW.pdf (SOW is a draft).

Happy to hop on a quick call this week to walk the numbers.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: annual prepay + staged ramp (ClearWave Health)

Jonas —

Appreciate the thoughtful proposal. A few clarifying asks from our side before we loop procurement in:

1) Ramp window: Can you move the soft ramp to 3 months rather than 6? We expect most of our usage to be production-ready within that window and would prefer a shorter grace period.
2) Discounting: The 20%/25% looks reasonable, but procurement will push for 25% in Year 1 if we commit 2 years. Can you escalate that?
3) Onboarding credits/scope: We need tighter language on what the $25k covers — specifically prompt engineering hours vs dedicated onboarding support. Can you provide a line-item in the SOW?
4) Termination protection: We need a rollback protection clause — if we miss year 1 usage by >30% due to product issues, we’re looking for a partial refund or increased credit rather than an immediate true-up.

Also: we require SOC2 evidence and a short list of references in the healthcare vertical (two customers). Procurement will want those before signing.

If you can get back with a 3-month ramp + a strengthened termination protection and clearer SOW line-items, we’ll take this to procurement next week.

Best,
Lena
VP Product Operations — ClearWave Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: annual prepay + staged ramp (ClearWave Health)

Jonas — forwarding Lena's reply. She is pushing hard on a 3-month ramp and wants 25% in Year 1 for a 2-year commit. Procurement will also request SOC2 and healthcare references.

My read / recommended counter:
- We can tighten the SOW to include line-items: 40 hours prompt engineering, 20 hours migration support, rollout QA checklist (attach to SOW). That keeps scope controlled.
- Ramp window: agree to 3 months soft ramp (instead of 6) but convert onboarding credit to $20k if they insist on 3 months (we'd have reduced risk exposure).
- Discounting: Finance limit is 22% Year 1 on a 2-yr commit; we can offer 22% with a 3-month ramp + $20k onboarding credit, plus a Year 2 accelerator to 25% after achieving agreed usage milestones.
- Termination protection / rollback: we can offer a one-time operational credit equal to 10% of Year 1 prepay if underperformance >30% and attributable to Redwood platform outage/latency (requires documented incident post-mortem). This avoids open-ended refunds but gives them protection.

Ben — can you confirm finance is ok with 22% Year 1 + accelerator and $20k credit for 3-month ramp?
Karthik — want to loop you in for approval to offer the SLA exception language (operational credit vs cash refund).

On attachments: I attached a draft SOW (SOW-Onboarding-CW.pdf) with suggested line items and a pricing matrix.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Lena — thanks for the quick review and helpful feedback. After alignment with finance and CS, here is our updated counter-offer for ClearWave:

Counter-offer (what we can commit to now):
- Term: 2-year annual prepay (preferred) with option to convert to 1-year on renewal.
- Pricing: 22% discount off posted rates in Year 1 (2-yr commit). Year 2 accelerator to 25% if agreed usage milestones are met (outlined below).
- Ramp / true-up: 3-month soft ramp window. Monthly usage true-ups thereafter.
- Onboarding: $20,000 professional services credit (applies to migration and prompt engineering); SOW now includes 40 hrs prompt engineering + 20 hrs migration support (see attached SOW-Onboarding-CW.pdf).
- Rollback protection: If Year 1 usage is >30% below the agreed baseline and the shortfall is directly attributable to documented Redwood platform incidents, ClearWave will receive a one-time operational credit equal to 10% of Year 1 prepay. Credit issuance requires incident post-mortem and mutual agreement on attribution.
- SLA: We will include a 99.9% uptime SLA with tiered service credits; low-latency SLA available as an add-on for committed customers.
- Early termination: 90-day notice and pro-rated refund less the 6-month minimum true-up.

Usage milestones for Year 2 accelerator (examples; final language to be added to agreement):
- 70% of baseline commitment in at least 9 of 12 months in Year 1 -> unlock 25% in Year 2.

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, I’ll push the updated SOW and term sheet to DocuSign and loop procurement.
2) You requested SOC2 and references — attaching our SOC2 summary and a short list of healthcare references in the Doc (we will include full artifacts under NDA).
